candidates.buyer: Small associations (village, hometown, mosque-building, sports and professional associations) with volunteer treasurers
candidates.existing: DERBİS is the free state portal. The competitor search (dernek otomasyon programı DERBİS aidat takip) returned no vendor, which is inconclusive. Vendor presence is unverified.
candidates.name: Annual declaration and ledger pack for small associations (DERBİS)
candidates.trigger: Dernekler Law 5253 and Dernekler Yönetmeliği: annual declaration by 30 April, member changes within 30 days via DERBİS, five mandatory books, fine for late filing
candidates.unchecked: Number of active associations, any paid dernek software vendors, willingness to pay, and whether the fine is a real pain point.

candidates.buyer: Small jewellers, plus dealers in the same obliged-party class (galerici, emlakçı)
candidates.existing: The competitor search (kuyumcu programı MASAK kimlik tespiti) found no named product. Jeweller ERPs probably bundle this; unverified.
candidates.name: Jeweller MASAK ID-check and suspicious-transaction log
candidates.trigger: Law 5549 and MASAK regulation: ID check at 185,000 TL and above, suspicious-transaction report within 10 working days, 8-year retention. Fines per transaction of roughly 284,000 TL (ID check) and 474,000 TL (reporting), from a law-firm blog and unverified. MASAK sector warning in March 2025.
candidates.unchecked: Whether jeweller ERPs (for example the big kuyumcu program vendors) already include MASAK modules, the real fine amounts from Resmî Gazete, and the number of small jewellers.

candidates.buyer: Small lift maintenance firms; building managers
candidates.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
candidates.existing: The competitor search (asansör bakım firması programı periyodik kontrol takip) found no product, only tenders and regulations. Apsiyon/Hursoft (K21) are building-management tools.
candidates.name: Lift maintenance firm and building-manager inspection and label tracker
candidates.trigger: Asansör İşletme, Bakım ve Periyodik Kontrol Yönetmeliği: yearly inspection by A-type body, lift ID number, green/blue/yellow/red labels with 2-4 month defect deadlines (partly from forum sources), monthly maintenance slip. Public Asansör Takip Sistemi (ATS) exists.
candidates.unchecked: Whether lift service software exists (narrower query not run), number of small maintenance firms, and the label-colour rules from a primary source.

candidates.buyer: Small workshop and factory owners with forklifts, pressure vessels, compressors, cranes and scaffolds
candidates.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
candidates.existing: OSGB and İSG software are rejected as K10/K19. Whether a reminder-only tool for the equipment owner exists is unchecked.
candidates.name: Work-equipment periodic inspection calendar and İSG-KATİP contract tracker for small workshops
candidates.trigger: Work Equipment Regulation amended 23 Dec 2025 (RG 33116): Annex-III-only scope, İSG-KATİP contract at least 1 day before inspection, records kept, mobile equipment carries its last report.
candidates.unchecked: Annex-III scope, whether OSGB firms already remind clients, and the competitor search was not run.

candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections (childminders and nurseries)
candidates.existing: One law-firm page (fetched) says the window ran 3 Jan 2025 to 3 Jan 2026, so the one-off deadline has passed. Another source suggests the clock may run from the Dec 2025 text; unresolved. Compliance is physical, not software.
candidates.name: Child-club conversion helper (MEB transition)
candidates.trigger: Geçici Madde 4 added to the ASHB regulation on 27 Dec 2025 (RG 33120) points to MEB regulation temporary article 32: one-year window to qualify as another private institution
candidates.unchecked: The true deadline from the Resmî Gazete, the number of child clubs, and whether the 2026 public-nursery regulation (RG 33293, 27 Jun 2026) adds recurring reporting.

candidates.existing: Hardware and tracking vendors serve this. No SaaS gap seen. Source is a single news item.
candidates.name: Commercial passenger vehicle camera, tracking and panic-button compliance (taxi, dolmuş, minibus, school service)
candidates.trigger: Highway Traffic Regulation change of 19 Aug 2025: M2/M3 vehicles need tracking, camera and panic button, phased by model year at the first inspection after 1 Jan 2026, 1 Jan 2027 and 1 Jan 2028. Taxi fiscal device mandate (Mar 2026 news).
candidates.unchecked: Official text, which vendors sell the compliant bundles, and whether a software layer is needed.

candidates.buyer: Households employing cleaners or carers under 10 days a month
candidates.existing: The free e-Devlet screens already do the filing. The competitor search was not run (budget used up).
candidates.name: Daily day-worker (gündelikçi) notification reminder and premium helper for households
candidates.trigger: SGK rule for under-10-day domestic work: each working day must be notified on e-Devlet that same day, otherwise the month cannot be filed. Premium of about 2,839 TL for 10 days at minimum wage in 2025 (Habertürk).
candidates.unchecked: Any existing app or service, fine amounts, how many households comply, and willingness to pay.

candidates.existing: A state system handles it (ARIBİS name unconfirmed). The buyer is rural and cheap.
candidates.name: Bee colony plate, movement and migratory-beekeeping paperwork
candidates.trigger: 2022 regulation on identification and registration of bee colonies: hive plates, bee movement document, notification within 30 days, per-colony fine
candidates.unchecked: The state system's coverage, migratory permit rules, and any existing apps.

candidates.buyer: Small vet clinics and polyclinics, vet-product retail points
candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.existing: Not checked. Clinic software vendors probably integrate with the state systems.
candidates.name: Veterinary e-prescription and drug-trace record keeping for small clinics and veterinary-product sellers
candidates.trigger: Veterinary Medicinal Products Regulation: prescriptions on the HAYBİS e-reçete module, İTS tracking, purchase and sale records
candidates.unchecked: Current duties, vendor landscape, and clinic count.

candidates.name: Private employment bureau quarterly İŞKUR statistics and permit compliance
candidates.trigger: İŞKUR regulation: statistics by the 20th of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct, 10-day change notices, deposit, records kept 5 years
candidates.unchecked: Number of bureaus, current rules (source is 2015), and any existing tool.

candidates.existing: MoTAT telematics vendors such as Seyir Mobil are noted in K06. Septic-only duties are unverified.
candidates.name: Vacuum-truck (vidanjör) and waste-hauler UATF and licence tracking
candidates.trigger: Waste Transport Communiqué: vehicle and firm licence, MoTAT tracking, UATF forms kept 5 years; municipal vidanjör permit
candidates.unchecked: Whether septic waste needs a licence or UATF at all, and the municipal permit rules.

candidates.buyer: Livestock traders and animal transport operators
candidates.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
candidates.existing: The state TÜRKVET system does the filing. Sources are old.
candidates.name: Livestock transport VSR and TÜRKVET arrival-entry helper
candidates.trigger: Domestic animal transport regulation: authorisation, vehicle approval, driver certificate, VSR valid 3 days, TÜRKVET arrival entry, disinfection logs
candidates.unchecked: Current rules and any private tools.

candidates.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
candidates.existing: Exchange offices probably already run purpose-built software; unchecked.
candidates.name: Money-changer (döviz bürosu) ID-check log
candidates.trigger: Authorised Institutions communiqué change of 12 Oct 2021: ID check on every foreign-exchange transaction with no lower limit; MASAK obligations
candidates.unchecked: Vendors and the number of offices.

candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections (driving schools)
candidates.existing: Automation software already exists (Tamindir 'Sürücü Kursu Otomasyonu' trial); several course-specific student apps. MEBBİS integration unverified.
candidates.name: Driving-school management software
candidates.unchecked: MEBBİS integration, the market leaders, and the current MEB reporting duties.

candidates.known_note: Same buyer group and core duty as K05. The search confirms the Dec 2024 governorate order. Only Istanbul found; no national rule seen.
candidates.name: Istanbul second-hand and scrap purchase document register
candidates.trigger: Istanbul Governorate notice of 6 Dec 2024: purchase document with seller ID, item and quantity, cameras, 1-year retention
candidates.unchecked: Other provinces issuing the same order.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Two SGK regimes: monthly 10+ days (e-bildirge via 'kolay işverenlik' on turkiye.gov.tr) and under 10 days (gündelikçi) where every working day must be notified on e-Devlet that same day. Both run on free state portals. Foreign carers need an e-İzin work permit under 'Ev Hizmetleri'. Candidate C07 (weak). Nothing found on third-party tools.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Istanbul Governorate decision of 6 Dec 2024 requires scrap and second-hand dealers to issue an 'İkinci El Malzeme Alım Satım' document (ID, address, item, quantity), keep it 1 year and install cameras. Nothing new beyond K05. Peddler scrap collectors need municipal or provincial environment-directorate papers (details unverified).

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Same Istanbul purchase-document duty (phones, computers, white goods, batteries, copper). Nothing new beyond K05. Pawnbroker-specific duties were not searched separately, so they are unverified.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Jewellers are MASAK obliged parties under Law 5549: ID check at 185,000 TL and above, suspicious-transaction report within 10 working days, 8-year record keeping. MASAK warned the sector in March 2025. Candidate C02. The competitor search was inconclusive, since jeweller ERP vendors are unverified.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: The ÖTA Regulation (RG 27448, 30 Dec 2009, amended 2010) sets authorised treatment facilities with an environmental licence, labelling and barcoding of reusable parts. No 2025-26 change found. A 20 Jun 2026 end-of-life vehicle bill exists but has no incentive. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Transport rules: transporter authorisation, vehicle approval, driver certificate, veterinary health report (VSR) valid 3 days, arrival entry in TÜRKVET, disinfection records. All on the state TÜRKVET/HAYBİS system. Candidate C13 (weak). Sources are dated 2013-2016, so currency is unverified.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Only the 2011 food-business registration/approval regulation and label rules turned up. No 2025 rule making butchers use TÜRKVET or künye. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: The 2022 regulation on identifying and registering bee colonies requires hive plates, a bee movement document (arı nakil belgesi) and notification within 30 days, with per-colony fines. Candidate C08 (weak). ARIBİS could not be confirmed.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Veterinary e-prescription runs on the HAYBİS module (test launch 15 Jul 2017) with İTS tracking. Retail sellers must keep purchase and sale records. Candidate C09 (weak). VetBİS could not be confirmed.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Only the old Groundwater Regulation (DSİ well licences, licensed drillers) turned up. No 2025 meter or driller-licence rule found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Waste transport needs a vehicle and firm licence from the provincial directorate, MoTAT tracking, and a UATF national waste transport form kept 5 years. Vidanjör (vacuum-truck) operators also need a municipal permit. Candidate C11 (weak); close to K06.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: The work equipment regulation was amended on 23 Dec 2025 (RG 33116): periodic inspection applies only to Annex-III equipment, an İSG-KATİP contract is needed at least 1 day before an inspection, and isekipmanlari.csgb.gov.tr is the official channel. Lifts: A-type inspection bodies, yearly inspection, coloured labels, building owner liable. Candidates C03 and C04 (both weak).

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: The 2005 drinking-water regulation (amended 2013) excludes individual sources under 10 m3/day or 50 users, unless the water goes to commercial or public use. The Health Directorate samples. A Bolu indictment lists village headman duties: clean and disinfect twice a year and keep chlorination working. No 2025 rule on registration or sampling frequency found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K03. No search run; the known idea already covers it.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Private employment bureaus need an İŞKUR permit with a deposit. They must send quarterly statistics (20 Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct), keep records 5 years and report changes within 10 days. Candidate C10 (weak); the buyer pool is small.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Rules are mostly municipal bylaws plus the Regulation on Cemetery Construction and Funeral Transport and Burial. Burial within 24 hours after handover. Road transport needs a municipal permit. No vehicle licensing rule or software need found.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Associations file an annual declaration through DERBİS by 30 April (2026 fine about 15,000 TL), report member changes within 30 days, and keep decision, receipt, inventory and account books plus a member register. Candidate C01 (weak). Halal: the 2023 HAK law change makes certifying bodies need HAK accreditation. No duty falls on small food firms, so no candidate.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: The Highway Traffic Regulation change of 19 Aug 2025 requires tracking, camera and panic button on M2/M3 commercial passenger vehicles, phased at the first inspection after 1 Jan 2026, 1 Jan 2027 and 1 Jan 2028. A taxi fiscal device is mandatory (a Mar 2026 news item). Candidate C06 (weak, hardware-led). U-ETDS is K09.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers: since 12 Oct 2021, ID checks are required with no lower limit (Authorised Institutions communiqué). Candidate C14 (weak). Market traders and street vendors were not searched.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Nurseries: ASHB regulation amended 27 Dec 2025; child clubs removed and moved to MEB, with a 1-year conversion window from 3 Jan 2025 that ended 3 Jan 2026 (C05). Tattoo studios: municipal sanitary-premises licence plus MYK qualification, no inspection register found. Driving schools: automation software already exists (Tamindir 'Sürücü Kursu Otomasyonu'). Small food producers and hunting outfitters were not searched.
